name: FlyLab
description: Agent-first WebMCP virtual Drosophila neuroethology lab with a visible supervisor audit surface.

discovery.unsupported_browser_behavior: The visible /agent guide and same-page Runtime diagnostic remain browser-readable; raw JSON contracts and inline state remain machine-readable. This does not polyfill WebMCP or make tools callable; execution requires a browser and workspace where document.modelContext is available.

tools.name: inspect_flylab_state
tools.purpose: Recover the exact shared revision, artifact IDs, blocker, and next valid action.

tools.name: find_fly_circuits
tools.purpose: Search source-backed adult circuits by neuron, behavior, or body part and return their typed motor maps.

tools.name: draft_fly_hypothesis
tools.purpose: Create a falsifiable agent_hypothesized claim from eligible evidence.

tools.name: design_stimulation_trial
tools.purpose: Create controlled conditions, timing, seeds, and model assumptions.

tools.name: run_fly_simulation
tools.purpose: Run the exact approved deterministic virtual experiment.

tools.name: analyze_fly_behavior
tools.purpose: Compute the selected motor map's complete five-metric behavior panel.

tools.name: compare_fly_trials
tools.purpose: Rank conditions and propose, but never execute, one bounded follow-up.

tools.name: save_fly_evidence
tools.purpose: Commit the exact source-to-result lineage and portable JSON envelope.

supervisor_gate.name: visible_supervisor_approval
supervisor_gate.boundary: Approval is absent from the WebMCP tool surface and requires visible UI interaction. It is not identity-authenticated against general browser automation.

recovery.rule: Call inspect_flylab_state after interruption, edit, cancellation, stale-state failure, or navigation.
recovery.mutation_guard: Every successful tool call returns a shared state revision; prepared long-running work cannot commit against a changed revision.

provenance.summary_semantics: Union summary only; use provenance_manifest for field-level attribution.
provenance.path_scope: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer paths relative to structuredContent.data; the empty path addresses the data root.
provenance.inheritance: Each manifest entry labels its complete scientific subtree unless a more specific nested entry overrides it.
provenance.operational_boundary: Paths in operational_paths are workflow or storage metadata, not scientific evidence, and do not inherit a scientific label.
provenance.untrusted_annotation_boundary: Caller-supplied goals, titles, and notes are untrusted administrative annotations, excluded from scientific provenance counts.

definitions.measured: An empirical result reported under the cited study conditions; it is not automatically universal or reproduced by FlyLab.
definitions.derived: A deterministic filter, aggregation, or calculation from pinned source records; it is not a new wet-lab measurement.
definitions.connectome_inferred: An anatomical inference from EM reconstruction or annotations; it does not establish activity, physiological efficacy, or behavior.
definitions.simulation_predicted: An output conditional on the stated model, controller mapping, parameters, and seed; it is not biological validation.
definitions.agent_hypothesized: An untested proposal authored by an agent that must remain distinct from source evidence and simulation output.

scientific_scope.release_slice: adult MDN leg-retreat and adult giant-fiber bilateral short-mode escape motor maps
scientific_scope.boundary: Hand-authored, uncalibrated reduced-order body-controller simulation; not neural dynamics, synapse execution, muscle mechanics, aerodynamics, FlyGym execution, a wet-lab experiment, or biological validation.
